traits.fruit_surface.note: Anderson, The Cactus Family (2001) pp. 327 to 328, Ferocactus: pericarpel with conspicuous deltoid to rounded scales, its areoles naked; fruit globose to oblong, thick walled.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Anderson, The Cactus Family (2001) p. 328, Ferocactus: flowers short funnelform, funnelform or bell-shaped, with a ring of hairs inside the perianth; fruit globose to oblong.

traits.note: The Flora of North America's account of Ferocactus, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): stigma lobes 13 to 20, unusually long, yellow, orange or red; the carpels are as many as the stigma lobes (Hamburg's Botany Online on the family, as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read).

traits.stem_form.note: Britton and Rose's The Cactaceae (vol. 3, 1922, p. 123): globular to cylindric, often large, normally one stem growing on at its tip (branching mostly after injury), with thick, prominent ribs.
